$comment: Canonical schema for the MCP tool contract used in this MVP. All tools exposed by the localsearch MCP server must conform to these input/output shapes.

ToolInput.title: ToolInput
ToolInput.description: Input parameters for the echo tool.

ToolResult.title: ToolResult
ToolResult.description: Successful structured result returned by the echo tool. The agent can reference individual fields by name.

ToolError.title: ToolError
ToolError.description: Structured MCP error response returned when a tool call fails.

code.description: MCP JSON-RPC error code. -32602=invalid params, -32601=method not found, -32000=server error.

data.description: Optional structured error context (e.g., validation details).

MCPContentBlock.title: MCPContentBlock
MCPContentBlock.description: A single content block within a tool result. For structured dict returns, type is always 'text' and text is a JSON-encoded object.
